moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean make chart history
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' remains at UK No.1 for a record-breaking 22nd non-consecutive week, becoming the longest-running UK number-one single of all time.

angles.name: Chart Record
angles.copy: History made! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is officially the longest-running UK No.1 EVER with 22 weeks at the top. Are you still streaming it?

angles.name: Unstoppable Duet
angles.copy: 22 weeks at No.1! Sam Fender and Olivia Dean are unstoppable with 'Rein Me In'. What's your favourite lyric from the track?
